summary: Follow-up verification of manual-sell dedup fix + null-body regression fix from iteration_32. Both confirmed FIXED via live testing against real paper account (PA36RNHPHRUZ): (1) manual SELL through POST /api/orders now returns a proper order object (not null) - verified with multiple live buy/sell round-trips on AAPL, correctly persisted to `orders` collection and logged to `trade-history` on full close. (2) Successfully reproduced the actual dedup/409 race by firing two concurrent SELL requests for the same symbol - first returned HTTP 200 with order object, second correctly returned HTTP 409 'already pending, please wait' instead of a raw Alpaca 500. (3) Manual BUY unaffected, still returns proper order object. (4) UI Sell All button on OpenPositionsPanel confirmed working end-to-end (position went from 2 shares to 0, order correctly filled and visible via API). Ran full existing pytest suite (45 tests) - 44 passed, 1 pre-existing failure (stale hardcoded paper account number in test) fixed as part of this pass since it was a trivial test-data staleness issue, not a real bug.

minor.issue: alpaca_service.get_position_entry_time still calls GetOrdersRequest with OrderStatus.FILLED enum instead of the QueryOrderStatus fix applied elsewhere (server log: "Input should be 'open', 'closed' or 'all' [type=enum, input_value=<OrderStatus.FILLED..."). Falls back gracefully (trade history still logs with a fallback timestamp) so not user-facing, but worth a follow-up fix for accurate entry_time in trade history.

action_items: No action required for the 2 items in scope (dedup fix, null-body regression) - both genuinely fixed and verified live.

Optional/low-priority: fix alpaca_service.get_position_entry_time's OrderStatus.FILLED enum usage (same class of bug already fixed elsewhere for get_orders) - currently degrades gracefully via fallback, not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py place_order() sell branch (line 549-561) correctly routes through position_monitor._sell_with_dedup() and translates a None result into HTTP 409 with a clear message - matches the automatic exit path pattern exactly as intended.

Live concurrency test (2 simultaneous curl POSTs for the same symbol/side) deterministically reproduced the 409 path: first request 200 with full order object, second 409 'A sell order for AAPL is already pending - please wait a few seconds for it to fill, then retry.' Confirms the dedup wiring works under real race conditions, not just the existing mocked unit tests.

Regression confirmed fixed: sell order response now includes order_id/symbol/qty/side/status/filled_avg_price/created_at - no null body. Order correctly persisted to db.orders and, on full close, trade-history entry created with correct entry/exit price and P&L.

BUY path unchanged and unaffected - still calls alpaca_service.place_market_order directly, verified with 3 separate buy calls all returning proper order objects and correctly auto-added to position_monitor.

Fixed one stale/unrelated test: test_auth_and_account_safety.py hardcoded the OLD paper account number (PA30RVV1A2DM) which was rotated per test_credentials.md to PA36RNHPHRUZ - updated the constant so the full suite passes 45/45 (was 44/45).

success_rate.backend: 100% (45/45 pytest, all live API checks passed)

seed_data_creation: Placed and closed several live AAPL round-trip orders (buy 1/sell 1, buy 2/sell 1+1 via concurrent race test, buy 2/sell all via UI) on the real paper account to exercise the fix - account confirmed FLAT (no open positions, no open orders) at end of session.

Account left flat/clean. No further action needed on this specific fix.
